title: Great Pyramid as a transmitter

tellings.quote: transmitter okay M of signal whatever they want to whoever they want to talk to

plain: The Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt may have been a transmitter, sending signals to whoever its builders wanted to talk to. A researcher named Joe McMoneagle suggests this on the show without naming a source, in an episode where he also argues that Mars once had life. If it were true, the pyramid would be a communication device rather than only a tomb.
